reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia. With our new native sparse flow system, water depth is now calculated more efficiently, ensuring smoother gameplay without freezing frames. You can raise, dig, and shape the land without lag, making your city-building experience even more immersive. Check out the full details of these updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: Water That Sees Dirt Edits - Major Update
steam.body: We're excited to announce a major update to the water mechanics in Provincia! With our new native sparse flow system, water depth calculations are now more efficient, allowing for a more immersive city-building experience. You can shape the land without worrying about lag or freezing frames. Explore the full details of this update and see how it enhances your gameplay: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
